about: Every world on the galaxy and every realm page. coax/web/realms.ts writes realms.coax (the galaxy's table) and realms/<slug>/index.html from it. docs/metaverse/realm-host.md is the contract.

realm.title: Everglade
realm.description: Everglade, the forest city in a forest you leave only by its trails: walk its streets and rooms, talk to its people, and cast from a spell bar where every spell rolls its attack, saving throw and damage on the SRD 5e rules.
realm.share: A forest city you leave only by its trails: walk its streets, talk to its people, and cast a spell bar that rolls on the SRD 5e rules. In your browser.
realm.alt: Everglade, the forest city, with its spell bar

realm.title: Everglade Nights Experimental
realm.description: An unlisted owner-local NWN character creator and woodland world. Requires an installed private source pack.
realm.alt: Native NWN characters exploring forest, rural and city areas

realm.title: Archery Range
realm.description: Shoot the Ranger's Longbow at straw butts from 10 to 70 metres for points, on foot, from horseback and from dragonback, and see your tally by distance.
realm.share: Draw the Ranger's Longbow and shoot for points at 10 to 70 metres, on foot, from horseback and from dragonback.

realm.title: Fairy Forest
realm.description: Fairy Forest, a park laid out like Central Park, faded round a sleeping heart tree: you are a fairy who wakes in Mossbank, by the Pond. Bloom the grey patches back to colour, help the creatures of the glades and wake the heart tree's roots.
realm.share: You are a fairy who wakes by the Pond in a faded park. Bloom the grey back to colour, help the creatures of the glades and wake the heart tree. In your browser.
realm.alt: Fairy Forest: a fairy with jewel wings on a path in the park, a hedgehog by the trees

realm.title: Dead Gears
realm.description: Dead Gears, a Metaverse realm in the browser: hold a ship's hold against three waves of crawlers, hounds, reavers and brutes with a cutter that severs limbs, telekinetic lift and stun, and a support engineer, then repair the reactor between waves.
realm.share: Hold a ship's hold against three waves of crawlers, hounds and brutes with a limb-cutting tool and telekinesis, then repair the reactor between waves. In your browser.
realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse: hold the ship in Dead Gears

realm.line: Hard sci-fi strategy on the real orbits of 2200
realm.title: Belt 2200
realm.description: Belt 2200, a hard sci-fi strategy game in the browser: the solar system in the year 2200 on real orbits. Run the Free Belt's Hearth Station at Ceres, plan burns and coasts with their delta-v, propellant and time, and mine ice while the Mars Union and the Terran Compact fly their own routes.
realm.share: Hard sci-fi strategy on real orbits: run Hearth Station at Ceres in the year 2200, plan burns by their delta-v and mine ice while rival powers fly their routes.
realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse: the solar system in 2200 in Belt 2200

realm.line: Rocket roadster ball in a glass arena in orbit
realm.title: Orbit League
realm.description: Orbit League, a Metaverse realm you play in the browser: drive an electric roadster with a rocket boost and play ball against a bot in a glass arena in orbit, where the station spins down to zero-g every 90 seconds.
realm.share: Car ball in orbit: drive a rocket-boosted electric roadster against a bot in a glass arena, where the station spins down to zero-g every 90 seconds. In your browser.
realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse: play Orbit League, car ball in orbit

realm.title: Fixture World
realm.description: The world host's test world: its own module, its own save slot and its own asset pack, opened by its address like any world.

realm.title: Anime Lab
realm.description: Direct an anime with your voice: spoken lines become typed directions, and an anime scene at Skyreach Academy plays them as you speak. The demo's voice is simulated.

realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse

realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse

realm.title: WorldBuilder
realm.description: Chat a world onto an empty grid: say what to put where, and 785 Quaternius models appear.
realm.alt: An empty grid with one line to type in

realm.title: A World You Built
realm.description: A world someone built from one prompt at /worlds/new: only the features they kept, and the tools its owner gives visitors.
realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse

realm.line: Open ground everyone builds on together
realm.title: Sandbox
realm.description: The Sandbox, open ground in the OpenAgents Metaverse that everyone builds on together: press B to edit, move, paint or copy what's there or place crates, barrels, lamps, trees and rocks, and what you build is published for everyone.
realm.share: Open ground in the Metaverse that everyone builds on together: place crates, lamps, trees and rocks, paint and move them, and what you build is there for everyone.
realm.alt: Enter the Metaverse: build on the Sandbox's open ground

realm.line: Tower defense on the SRD 5e rules
realm.title: Hold the Stair
realm.description: Hold the Stair, a Metaverse realm in the browser: a popping tower defense on the SRD 5e rules. Bubble-beasts climb a wizard's tower and pop into the layers inside; place fighters, wizards and clerics beside the stair, and every attack rolls a real d20.
realm.share: A popping tower defense on the SRD 5e rules: bubble-beasts climb a wizard's tower, you place fighters, wizards and clerics by the stair, and every attack rolls a d20.
realm.alt: Hold the Stair: bubble-beasts climb the tower stair past a party of adventurers

realm.title: Watchtower
realm.description: Watchtower, a cyber defense range in the browser: an intruder works through a small company network toward the vault. Read the sensor log, scan, isolate and reimage hosts, and evict it before the vault is emptied or the business goes dark.
realm.share: A cyber defense range: read the log, find the intruder, isolate and clean hosts before it empties the vault.
realm.alt: Watchtower: a company network on a glowing isometric grid, with red alerts on an infected host

realm.title: Character Studio
realm.description: Create a Quaternius human in the OpenAgents Metaverse Engine. Mix all 76 Fantasy Source clothing parts, three colourways, skin, hair and details with a live animated preview.
realm.share: Make someone yours: a live Metaverse Engine character wardrobe.

features.title: Real 5E rules
features.line: Levels 1 to 6 on the D&D 5E SRD.

realm.title: Everglade Classic
realm.description: Everglade Classic, a Metaverse realm in the browser: the forest city as it was before its spells rolled on the SRD 5e rules, with the quest board and its quests out to the deep wood, the ruins and the river crossing.
realm.share: The forest city as it was before the SRD 5e rules: take quests from the board out to the deep wood, the ruins and the river. In your browser.
realm.alt: Everglade Classic, the forest city: take a quest from the board

realm.title: One-Shot
realm.description: One-Shot, a Metaverse realm in the browser: a Game Master (GM) makes a short 5E adventure, runs it from the GM Screen, and players join by link or code with a hero the SRD 5e rules engine builds.
realm.share: Make a 5E one-shot, run it from the GM Screen, and play it with friends who join by link or code.
realm.alt: One-Shot: the GM Screen with scenes, an initiative tracker, the dice tray and the session log

realm.title: MetaHuman Lab
realm.description: MetaHuman Lab, a Metaverse realm in the browser: one human figure on a lit studio floor, driven by a skeleton on the Unreal mannequin's joint names and playing twelve animation clips.
realm.share: A human figure on a skeleton with the Unreal mannequin's joint names, playing twelve clips on a studio floor.
realm.alt: MetaHuman Lab: a figure standing on a grey studio floor

realm.title: Audio Lab
realm.description: Audio Lab: every Everglade sound by name, each candidate for it with its waveform, loudness and length, and a 20 second raid played through the game's mixer.
realm.share: Every Everglade sound, its candidates side by side, and a raid played through the game's mixer.
realm.alt: Audio Lab: rows of Everglade's sounds, each with its waveform and candidates

realm.title: Valley Lab
realm.description: An unlisted Coax/Metaverse Engine workbench: walk the basin, inspect an original content-hashed rock, and compare full-detail indexed geometry, normals, lighting and depth.
realm.alt: An original sandstone boulder and measured bounds in Valley Lab asset and mesh stations

realm.title: Portal Lab
realm.description: An unlisted owner-local Coax/Metaverse Engine recreation of a baked portal scene: orbit the glade, the swirling portal, its pole lamps and fireflies.
realm.alt: A baked night glade with a red and blue portal, two lamps and fireflies

realm.title: Valley Lab - Ancient World
realm.description: Explore a 250 metre Ancient World slice with Echo, 27,501 original placements and recovered source material maps.
realm.alt: Echo walking through the original sandstone basin in Valley Lab

realm.title: Valley Lab - Canyon Pair
realm.description: Walk with the original Echo avatar around the source Canyon Sandstone pair; inspect source geometry, animation, strands and material maps in the OpenAgents Metaverse Engine.
realm.alt: Two original Canyon Sandstone outcrops at their recovered Ancient World placements

realm.title: Splat Lab
realm.description: Splat Lab, a Metaverse realm in the browser: 3D Gaussian splats in WebGPU, sorted on the GPU, as fire, smoke, spells, a burning street and a ritual site.
realm.share: 3D Gaussian splats in the Metaverse's WebGPU renderer: fire, smoke, Fireball, Eldritch Blast, a burning street and a ritual site.
realm.alt: Splat Lab: a pyre of splat flames and smoke at night

realm.title: Bitcoin Lab
realm.description: An unlisted walk on the Grid through the Bitcoin book's first chapter: a byte, hex, base64 and byte order, then SHA-256, SHA-256d against the target, and a chain of recorded regtest blocks, plus 125 book chapters.
realm.alt: Your Everglade character on a glowing Grid lane beside lit stations showing a byte's bits, the genesis header in hex and a chain of block cubes

realm.title: Nostr Lab
realm.description: An unlisted walk on the Grid through Nostr from scratch: a key pair, an event, its ID and its signature, then a station for each NIP, from relays and encrypted group chat to Lightning zaps, each worked out live in Coax.
realm.alt: Your Everglade character on a glowing Grid lane beside lit stations showing a public key and npub, a Nostr event's fields and its ID out of SHA-256, with more stations for each NIP down the lane

realm.title: Coax Lab
realm.description: An unlisted walk on the Grid through the Coax programming language: declarations, a byte that stops at 255, a struct byte by byte, a table the compiler built, a check over 1,974 cases and a planted bug, each run live in Coax or shown as the compiler printed it.
realm.alt: Your Everglade character on a glowing Grid lane beside lit stations showing Coax source code, a byte counter stopped at 255 and a grid of green check cases

realm.title: Penultimate Frontier
realm.description: Penultimate Frontier: a slow camera flight through the Grid, the homepage's live projects drawn as trees of commits and tasks, updating from Nostr as you watch.
realm.alt: A camera flying low through the Grid's glowing project trees

realm.title: Animation Lab
realm.description: Inspect rigs and clips, compare retargeted poses, and toggle performance layers and contact fixes on a neutral Metaverse stage.
realm.alt: A character skeleton, skin weight colours and animation curves in a neutral studio

realm.title: Ocarina Lab
realm.description: A private source character workbench: Link's original rig, eight skin influences, recovered materials and source locomotion in a walkable Metaverse Engine forest.
realm.alt: Link exploring a winding forest path in Ocarina Lab

realm.title: Painted Village
realm.description: Painted Village, a Metaverse realm in the browser: a hand-painted village road with a timber-frame cottage, a stone house, stone walls, trees and mountains, every asset generated from code by the Metaverse Engine's architecture kit and drawn by its stylized shading.
realm.alt: A dirt road between a timber-frame cottage and a stone house, toward a village and pale mountains under big clouds

realm.title: Crew
realm.description: Character creation for the Metaverse Engine's cel realms: six body shapes and one black wardrobe with white stitch lines, every garment fitted to the body that wears it.
realm.alt: Six people of very different builds in black work clothes with white stitching, standing in a row beside a height scale

realm.title: Splice Bots
realm.description: Splice Bots: a robot smuggler scavenges banned robot parts, splices them in a hidden edit bay and restores a scene the Emperor erased. Cel-shaded, with an ink-on-paper interface.
realm.alt: A cloaked smuggler beside a white rover at the mouth of a red desert mine, under a paper-and-ink game interface
